components.purpose: Core of the page — this component is purpose-built ('Meant for the blog post details page') to render the single Post item in context: Heading, Author, PostDate, Category, Tags, the featured Image, and the full HTML Content body. This alone fulfills 'shows a single blog article.'

Placed at the bottom, after the article. Not part of displaying the article itself, but a standard marketer addition to a blog-detail template — captures reader interest right after they finish the content.
